targetText: The commodities exist without it, and it itself remains what it is (or becomes even less by depreciation) whether in one turnover or in ten.
explanation: Capital turnover time consists of production time plus circulation time; reducing turnover time accelerates the annual rate of profit accumulation.

targetText: Before we resolve this seeming difficulty we must distinguish between the accumulation in department I (production of means of production) and in department II (production of articles of consumption).
explanation: Department I represents the branch of production that manufactures means of production (machinery, raw materials, industrial equipment).

targetText: Before we resolve this seeming difficulty we must distinguish between the accumulation in department I (production of means of production) and in department II (production of articles of consumption).
explanation: Department II represents the branch of social production that produces consumer goods and means of individual consumption.

targetText: Chapter 21: Accumulation and Reproduction on an Extended Scale Part 1 It has been shown in Book I how accumulation works in the case of the individual capitalist.
explanation: Social reproduction requires continuous exchange between Department I and Department II to balance industrial equipment needs with consumer wage goods.
